nodes.description: Private address granting privileged access; set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Public mapping of token balances held by each address.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances.
Whitelisted trading address exempted from the sale conditions.
Maximum number of sales allowed per address during a sale window.
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Counter of completed sales per address.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass sale restrictions.
Total token supply (declared but not otherwise updated outside constructor).
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used for supply and sale scaling.
Constant Uniswap router address that is treated as a trusted sender.
Initializes name, symbol, supply, owner, msg.sender balance and infinite router allowance.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Whitelist gate: passes for owner, UNI router, tradeAddress, canSale entries, else evaluates condition().
Core transfer path: spends allowance, applies ensure(), then mutates balances and _onSaleNum in place.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Evaluates _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits against _from's sale count and _value.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address.
Owner-only sale window configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only loop distributing _value to each address in _tos with unchecked total computation.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Pure helper computing the CREATE2 Uniswap pair address for two tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, approval and transfer origin.
Arbitrary delegatecall executed in the contract's storage context.
Raw `-=` on allowance and balanceOf without SafeMath, prune to arithmetic risk.
Raw `_value * _tos.length` and `addedValue*(10**decimals)` scaling without overflow checks.
Caller-supplied transfer amount used by transferFrom.
Source address argument of transferFrom, checked against whitelists.
Destination address argument of transferFrom.
Array of destination addresses passed to batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, computed with unchecked multiplication.
Loop counter iterating over the _tos array in batchSend.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
msg.sender becomes the owner without any two-step handover.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transfer passes the caller address as _from into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance spender check.
transferFrom requires the ensure() whitelist gate before mutating balances.
ensure falls through to condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
The sender-derived _from is compared against owner, UNI and tradeAddress.
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping to bypass restrictions.
transferFrom decrements and increments balanceOf entries.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
Raw `-=` on allowance and balanceOf lacks SafeMath overflow/underflow protection.
transferFrom increments the per-address _onSaleNum counter.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
delegate forwards arbitrary calldata into a delegatecall that executes in this contract's storage.
delegate gates the delegatecall only on msg.sender == owner.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting arbitrary callers.
_mints credits balanceOf[spender] from an unchecked scaled value.
init is restricted by msg.sender == owner.
init writes _minSale derived from token scaling.
init writes _maxSale derived from maxToken scaling.
init writes the sale count limit _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum to bound per-address sales.
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum value.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
batchSend is restricted by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend decrements the sender balance and increments each recipient balance.
batchSend consumes the _value parameter for every recipient.
batchSend iterates the caller-supplied _tos array.
Local total is the product involved in the unchecked multiplication.
The loop counter i is bounded by _tos.length.
transferFrom uses _value for allowance and balance arithmetic.
transferFrom reads _from for whitelist and balance operations.
transferFrom credits the _to recipient balance.
setTradeAddress overwrites tradeAddress after an owner check.
pairFor hashes factory and token addresses to derive a pair used in ensure().

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter only carries the amount consumed by transferFrom.
_from is the source address resolved inside transferFrom and its ensure() check.
_to is the recipient only credited inside transferFrom.
_tos is the recipient array iterated exclusively by batchSend.
Local total is the direct operand of the unchecked multiplication operation.
Loop counter i exists only to iterate the _tos array in batchSend.
